name: Matsunaga Keiko
source: The lecherous school nurse of Miyanomori High School, Keiko, is there to comfort any and all students who come to her infirmary. Whether they need somebody to assist them relieve their stress or if they need to hear a couple of words of wisdom, Keiko is always eager to help out her students. [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url] is one of those students who seem to be only interested in the latter, so once he transforms into [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]a girl[/url] again this year, he will eagerly seek out his favourite high school nurse.
